description: p8's input with a string appended to `attestations`: the ledger's address written where an attestation object belongs. Under an independence claim every attestation must be a JSON object carrying `by`, so the record rejects with independence_reject although p8's attestor outside the parties is still there. n16's only attestation is a string, so an engine that skips entries that are not objects still rejects n16, for want of an attestor outside the parties; it accepts this vector. p8 is the accepting twin.
